caption: The drawing depicts a four-poster canopy bed with a rectangular structure. The bed frame is made up of four vertical dark-colored posts, likely black or dark brown, supporting a canopy that covers the top of the bed. The canopy covering as well as the curtains draping down on the left and rear sides are a pale cream or beige color, featuring a scalloped edge with a decorative trim in green, gold, and black. The curtains are partially tied back, revealing a matching bedspread and cushion. The bedspread is light yellow or cream with a floral pattern consisting of red, orange, blue, and green flowers and vines scattered across its surface. The skirt underneath the mattress extends downward, also in a light, ruffled fabric matching the upper elements. The visible headboard and footboard are a reddish-brown wood. The floor or other background elements are not shown, with the focus entirely on the bed against a neutral, pale background.
title: Bedstead
